[SWS_SwCluC_02147]
Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00206
⌈The NvM High Proxy of a specific Application Software Cluster shall en-
able the configuration ID check, if the parameter NvMDynamicConfigura-
tion is set to TRUE in this Application Software Cluster.⌋
Note: The parameter NvMDynamicConfiguration is set in the NvM module config-
uration of the respective Application Software Cluster.
Like in the configuration of the NvM module in the Host Software Cluster, the
block ID 1 is reserved for the Configuration ID block in each Application
Software Cluster. This Configuration ID block to contain the stored NVRAM
configuration ID.
